paragraphs: I grew up on the internet, but my story starts somewhere quieter.

I come from a traditional South Indian family, where belief and ritual were part of everyday life. When I was a kid, my parents had my future read by a well-known astrologer. His prediction was heavy: I’d grow up to be exceptionally rare, almost lisan-al-gaib. To this day, that sits in my head.

I spent six years studying electronics at a college that won’t make headlines. Watching Tron at twelve had a huge influence on me and put me in pursuit of tech. I love building stuff. But apart from tech, I’ve spent a major part of my life doing other creative work: media production, leading marketing campaigns, and hosting communities.
Early on, I spent a fair amount of time in media. I used to work with bands, hospitality, and celebrities. You can check my gallery here. Later, I got back to my absolute favorite thing: tech.
I’m always on the lookout for doing something really significant with my life.
